features: Bagtank Storage Technology: Delivers ASTM Type 1 water from a closed, pressure-regulated storage system.
Touch-Activated Glove-Compatible Display: Shows dispensed volume, water quality, and temperature, operable with lab gloves.

Optional Point-of-Use Filters: Sterile Plus for bacteria removal, Cell Plus for endotoxins, RNase, DNase, and particles.
Continuous Contamination Protection: Closed-system pressure regulation blocks CO2 penetration and biofilm formation.
Optional Integrated UV Lamp: Available for applications needing additional purification assurance.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: Arium Mini Plus product information: purification stages, Bagtank technology, and display operation.
body: Arium Mini Plus provides ASTM Type 1/ultrapure water from Sartorius's innovative Bagtank storage, purified from pretreated water held in an internal storage bag.
Daily output covers up to approximately 10 liters of Type 1 water, suited to general and analytical lab applications.
The unit measures just 28 centimeters (11 inches) wide, a compact design with minimal footprint that integrates easily into any lab environment.
A touch-activated color display works seamlessly with laboratory gloves, showing the last volume dispensed, purified water quality, and water temperature directly.
Dispensing runs manually or in 50 mL increments, adding flexibility for different sample prep needs.
The 5-liter bag requires no chemical cleaning, lowering contamination risk, and swaps out easily via a leak-tight quick-connect coupling that preserves the closed system.

Purification runs through multiple stages: a pretreatment cartridge using high-quality carbon for effective absorption, reverse osmosis to retain impurities, and optional point-of-use filters, Arium Sterile Plus for bacteria removal down to 0.001 CFU/mL via a 0.22 μm membrane, and Arium Cell Plus for endotoxins, RNase, DNase, microorganisms, and particles.
The unit is available with or without an integrated UV lamp, depending on application needs.
Bagtank technology maintains a closed system throughout, automatically regulating pressure so no CO2 penetrates, preserving low conductivity and preventing biofilm formation.

sections.title: Continuous Contamination Protection
sections.description: Open water storage systems are vulnerable to secondary contamination the moment they're exposed to air. Arium Mini Plus avoids that risk entirely with a closed Bagtank system. Pressure inside the system regulates automatically, keeping CO2 from penetrating the stored water, which directly preserves low conductivity readings over time. That same closed environment prevents biofilm formation, a common failure point in lab water systems that rely on open reservoirs or infrequently cleaned tanks. The bag itself needs replacing roughly every six months depending on lab requirements, a predictable, low-effort maintenance cycle rather than an open-ended cleaning routine.

sections.title: Low-Maintenance by Design
body: Cleaning a water system with chemicals introduces exactly the kind of contamination risk a purification system exists to eliminate. Arium Mini Plus sidesteps that entirely.
The 5-liter bag requires no chemical cleaning at all, removing both the contamination risk and the recurring task from the maintenance routine.

A quick-connect coupling makes bag replacement fast and leak-tight, keeping the closed system intact through every swap rather than reopening it to potential contamination. Combined with a carbon pretreatment cartridge for effective absorption and reverse osmosis for impurity retention, the system's core purification stages need minimal day-to-day operator intervention.
